description: Portrait of O'Keeffe at the Abiquiu house, dressed in white jacket and matching skirt with hands on hip, leaning forward and smiling, another woman is walking behind her in light colored slacks and a patterned shirt with short curly hair and glasses.  Visible around the house is foliage and an adobe wall with double doors.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe and Unidentified Woman
